message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Java CI with Maven

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "develop" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "develop" ]

jobs:
  build:

    name: ${{ matrix.name }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: Java 22, pure Java
            os: ubuntu-latest
            java-version: '22'
            maven-args: -Dojalgo.native.library=none
            native: false
          - name: Java 27, native BLAS
            os: ubuntu-latest
            java-version: '27'
            maven-args: -DargLine=--enable-native-access=ojalgo,ALL-UNNAMED
            openblas: true
            native: true
          - name: Java 27, macOS, Accelerate
            os: macos-latest
            java-version: '27'
            maven-args: -DargLine=--enable-native-access=ojalgo,ALL-UNNAMED
            native: true
          - name: Java 27, Windows, no native library
            os: windows-latest
            java-version: '27'
            maven-args: -DargLine=--enable-native-access=ojalgo,ALL-UNNAMED
            native: false

    steps:
    - name: Keep line endings as committed
      if: runner.os == 'Windows'
      run: git config --global core.autocrlf false
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7
    - name: Install OpenBLAS
      if: matrix.openblas
      run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libopenblas0
    - name: Set up JDK ${{ matrix.java-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-java@v6
      with:
        java-version: ${{ matrix.java-version }}
        distribution: 'temurin'
    - name: Cache Maven packages
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.m2/repository
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-maven-
    - name: Build with Maven
      shell: bash
      run: ./mvnw -B package ${{ matrix.maven-args }}
      env:
        OJALGO_NATIVE_EXPECTED: ${{ matrix.native }}",
  "rationale": "Add a Maven dependency cache step after JDK setup and before the build. The repository builds with Maven (./mvnw -B package) and has a pom.xml, matching the measured experiment where adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.m2/repository keyed on hashFiles('**/pom.xml') reduced median elapsed time from 145s to 71s and median job runtime from 277s to 131s on a similar Java/Maven workflow. This preserves all matrix configurations, build args, tests, and required checks; it only reuses previously downloaded dependencies. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or privileged actions are added, and no new network access beyond the existing Actions cache service is introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-a89d5fd8d30bc8cb-r2"]
}
